mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, the market perceives restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as economic activity expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and employment growth signal labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face demand headwinds.
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and PAYEMS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annualized), rising housing starts signal resilient consumer demand that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as earnings growth expectations rise.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 3.5% periods, HOUST rising fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for regime-specific signal falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the prior 3 months indicates robust supply chain conditions and rising corporate output, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as growth expectations strengthen.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO increased over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months, the market anticipates reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as economic outlook weakens.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances despite UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation and the federal funds rate signal a hawkish monetary policy response to persistent inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates rise and growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: The joint increase in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1,400,000 units annually (HOUST annualized > 1400.0), the market interprets this as strong consumer demand for housing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings benefit from resilient spending.
failure_condition: HOUST annualized > 1400.0 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
